name: Jesus Second Coming
overview: The Scriptures reveal that Jesus Christ will return visibly and gloriously, accompanied by His holy angels, to establish His righteous reign (Matthew 25:31; Revelation 1:7). This second coming is described as a blessed hope and a glorious appearing of our great God and Savior (Titus 2:13), promised to those who eagerly await Him. While the exact timing of His return remains known only to the Father (Matthew 24:36), believers are assured that Christ will appear a second time without sin to bring salvation to those who look for Him (Hebrews 9:28).
